title: Assinado
summary: Adrian signs the New Balance technical apparel partnership; New Balance confirms at 10:17, but there is no public announcement yet.
keyEvents: New Balance becomes Kairos's first external commercial partner and Official Technical Apparel Partner for the 2027 competitive program.
The agreement covers all five rosters and competitive coaches and staff at the same material and production standard.
Adrian signs; New Balance confirms the agreement at 10:17.
Asterion Intelligence remains the parent company and Principal Institutional Partner.
No public announcement has occurred by the episode's end.
